panels.title: Orphans nobody deleted
panels.description: LVMLogicalVolumes whose PersistentVolume is gone and which nobody has asked to delete. This is what D8SdsLocalVolumeOrphanedLVMLogicalVolumes reads. A volume annotated storage.deckhouse.io/retain-acknowledged=true is counted as retained instead and is not in here.

targets.expr: max(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_count{state="active"})

panels.title: Retained on purpose
panels.description: Orphans an administrator has acknowledged with the storage.deckhouse.io/retain-acknowledged=true annotation. The same situation as "Orphans nobody deleted" with the question already answered: no alert reads this state, and a deletion is still unblocked normally when one is asked for.

targets.expr: max(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_count{state="retained"})

panels.title: Deletions in progress
panels.description: Orphans an administrator has asked to delete. The controller removes its finalizer within its grace period, so this should be transient; a value that sticks means sds-node-configurator is not removing the logical volume.

targets.expr: max(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_count{state="terminating"})

panels.title: Reclaims refused
panels.description: Deletions the controller is not completing. Which of the six reasons applies is in the reason label of sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes, broken down per volume in the "Which volumes are leaking" table below. snapshots_present, agent_finalizer_absent, persistent_volume_exists and successor_in_place are properties of the volume that the controller deliberately refuses to override; api_error and removal_failed are faults in the module, and the second also raises D8SdsLocalVolumeCSIFinalizerRemovalErrors.

targets.expr: max(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_count{state="blocked"})

panels.title: Volume group space held by orphans
panels.description: Space held in the volume groups by every orphaned LVMLogicalVolume, in any state. Thick volumes only: for a Thin volume the reported size is the virtual one and adding it here would present overprovisioning as allocated space.

targets.expr: sum(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes{type="Thick"})

panels.title: Thin virtual size held by orphans
panels.description: Virtual size of the orphaned Thin LVMLogicalVolumes. This is not space held in a volume group and is not comparable with the Thick figure: what a thin volume actually consumes is a property of its thin pool, which sds-node-configurator reports.

targets.expr: sum(sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes{type="Thin"})

panels.title: Awaiting sds-node-configurator
panels.description: Resources being deleted that carry no finalizer of this module any more and are waiting for sds-node-configurator to remove the logical volume. No orphan series covers them, for the same reason. Two things it counts that the title does not suggest: resources this module never owned — the absence of its finalizer cannot tell that from "already unblocked" — and deletions that are legitimately still running, because the agent erases the volume as spec.volumeCleanup says before lvremove. Time here is normal; D8SdsLocalVolumeLVMLogicalVolumeDeletionStuck fires only after two hours of it.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (sds_local_volume_awaiting_agent_count)

panels.title: Orphans by state

targets.expr: max by (state) (sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_count)

panels.description: The published states are active (nobody asked), retained (acknowledged), terminating (unblocked, inside its grace period or handed to the agent) and blocked (the module is refusing or failing to unblock).

panels.title: Space held by orphans, by state and type

targets.expr: sum by (state, type) (sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes)

panels.description: Read the Thick series as space held in the volume groups. The Thin series is virtual size, which is unrelated to what the thin pool consumes.

panels.title: Which volumes are leaking
panels.description: One row per LVMLogicalVolume whose PersistentVolume is gone. Size is space in the volume group for a Thick volume and virtual size for a Thin one. Reason is filled in only for a blocked reclaim and says what the module is refusing, or failing, to do. Delete a row with `d8 k delete lvmlogicalvolume <name>` once the data is confirmed to be no longer needed.

targets.expr: max by (name, lvm_volume_group, type, state, reason) (sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes)

panels.title: Snapshot deletions awaiting reclaim, by state

targets.expr: max by (state) (sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_snapshot_count)

panels.description: LVMLogicalVolumeSnapshots that have been asked to be deleted and still carry this module's finalizer. Terminating is the normal, short-lived state; blocked means the module is refusing or failing to unblock, and the source volume stays unreclaimable while it lasts.

panels.title: Which snapshot deletions are blocked
panels.description: One row per LVMLogicalVolumeSnapshot whose deletion the module is holding up. Each of these also keeps its source volume from being reclaimed, which shows up as reason="snapshots_present" on that volume.

targets.expr: max by (name, lvm_logical_volume, state, reason) (sds_local_volume_orphaned_lvm_logical_volume_snapshot_used_bytes)
max by (phase, type) (sds_local_volume_lvm_logical_volume_count)

panels.title: Size by phase and type

targets.expr: sum by (phase, type) (sds_local_volume_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes)

panels.description: Thick is space held in the volume groups; Thin is virtual size and says nothing about thin pool consumption.

panels.title: Total volume group space
panels.description: Space held in the volume groups by every LVMLogicalVolume in the cluster. Thick volumes only, for the same reason as the orphan figure above.

targets.expr: sum(sds_local_volume_lvm_logical_volume_allocated_bytes{type="Thick"})

panels.title: Reconcile RPS by controller and outcome

targets.expr: sum by (controller, result) (rate(sds_local_volume_reconciles_total[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (controller, le) (rate(sds_local_volume_reconcile_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CSI finalizer removals
panels.description: success is a finalizer actually written off, noop an attempt that found nothing left to do (the cache was behind, or DeleteVolume got there first), and error a failed write — the only one that raises an alert. A deliberate refusal is not counted here at all: it is reported as state="blocked" with a reason.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, result) (increase(sds_local_volume_csi_finalizer_removals_total[$__rate_interval]))
max by (name, phase) (sds_local_volume_local_storage_class_phase)

panels.title: Thick: volume group size
panels.description: Total size of the volume groups of the selected LocalStorageClass. Empty for a Thin class.

panels.title: Thick: free
panels.description: Free space left in the volume groups of the selected LocalStorageClass: what new Thick volumes of the class can still take. Empty for a Thin class.

targets.expr: sum(sds_node_configurator_lvg_vg_free_bytes * on (lvg_name) group_left (storage_class) max by (storage_class, lvg_name) (sds_local_volume_local_storage_class_lvg_info{storage_class="$storage_class", thin_pool=""}))

panels.title: Thick: used
panels.description: Share of the volume groups of the selected LocalStorageClass that is taken. It counts everything in the volume groups, not only the volumes of the class: thin pools and the volumes of other classes on the same volume groups as well. Empty for a Thin class.

panels.description: Total size of the thin pools of the selected LocalStorageClass. Empty for a Thick class.

panels.title: Thin: allocated to volumes
panels.description: Sum of the sizes of the volumes created in the thin pools of the selected LocalStorageClass: the virtual size they were requested with, not the data written into them. Empty for a Thick class.

targets.expr: sum((sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_left (storage_class) max by (storage_class, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_local_volume_local_storage_class_lvg_info{storage_class="$storage_class", thin_pool!=""}))

panels.title: Thin: allocation limit
panels.description: How much can be allocated to volumes in the thin pools of the selected LocalStorageClass: the pool size times the allocationLimit of each thin pool of the LVMVolumeGroup (150% by default). Empty for a Thick class.

targets.expr: sum((sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_left (storage_class) max by (storage_class, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_local_volume_local_storage_class_lvg_info{storage_class="$storage_class", thin_pool!=""}))

panels.title: Thin: free by allocationLimit
panels.description: What new volumes of the selected LocalStorageClass can still be given: allocation limit minus allocated, per thin pool, a pool already past its limit counting as zero. This is the space the module provisions against, so overprovisioning is taken into account. It says nothing about the data the pool can still hold; see Thin: data used. Empty for a Thick class.

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocation_limit_bytes - sds_node_configurator_lvg_thin_pool_allocated_size_bytes, 0)) * on (lvg_name, thin_pool) group_left (storage_class) max by (storage_class, lvg_name, thin_pool) (sds_local_volume_local_storage_class_lvg_info{storage_class="$storage_class", thin_pool!=""}))

panels.title: Thin: data used
